newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva Del. 442 MW unit restarts today.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva Del. 442 MW unit restarts today.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co's 442 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at its Indian River generation facility in Millsboro, Del., restarted today after being shut Aug 27 for repairs, the company said Thursday.
"They were bringing it back on line today," said Delmarva spokesman Michael Ratchford.
A malfunction with the unit's lube oil pump resulted a series of vibrations, which in turn, tripped the unit off line.
There are three other units at the Indian River complex, which have a combined capacity of 340 MW.
The Indian River station is operated and wholly-owned by Delmarva.
